purpose: Ten complete donor root/module ancestor and leaf tree objects for the existing seven-file consumer publication, plus two complete parent ancestry proof trees. No recursive repository census; docs trees intentionally reused from Root's separate custody.
verification: Each exact primaryRawJSON was parsed only after retrieval, required truncated=false, and independently reserialized as binary Git tree entries with Git path ordering, exact modes/types and object IDs to its reported SHA-1.
format: JSONL: header followed by 12 tree records; each primaryRawJSON string is the complete exact original Git API response content.
